title: Legislature Pay
scope: This ledger lists every person paid as a Massachusetts Representative or Senator on the CTHRU Commonwealth payroll file in calendar 2025, with base salary, Comptroller supplemental pay (AA1), stipends (A14), and total. Calendar 2025 is the last complete year. People who served in both chambers are one directory row with the stints added together.
exclusions: Does not cover House or Senate staff, municipal pay, other state jobs a member may hold, employer-paid GIC health or MSERS pension contributions (those are not named-employee lines on this file), the statutory office-expense allowance (not a named column here), calendar 2026 year-to-date as the headline, or advice about a member. Department-level Commonwealth payroll sits on Payroll and Vendors.
heritage: New. The Tableau suite did not publish a named legislator-pay directory.
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 16, 2026 from CTHRU Commonwealth Of Massachusetts Payroll v4 (Socrata 9ttk-7vz6), calendar 2025. Rows are people with department_code HOU or SEN and position_title Representative or Senator. Directory rows collapse one person across chambers. 225 payroll rows become 220 people because of mid-year replacements and chamber switches. Total pay equals base plus AA1 (Comptroller Salaries, supplemental) plus A14 (Stipends, bonus pay, and awards). Buyout and overtime are $0 on these rows. Employer-paid GIC and MSERS amounts are not on this file. Calendar 2026 is year-to-date (201 rows, $17.00 million) and is not the headline.

q: Salary, supplemental pay, and stipends for every Massachusetts representative and senator.
lead: People paid as a Massachusetts Representative or Senator received $26.51 million in calendar 2025 (SRC-632-01). Karen Spilka and Ronald Mariano each received $223,720, the House Speaker and Senate President totals (SRC-632-01). The House median was $111,864; the Senate median was $156,726 (SRC-632-01). Employer-paid health and pension contributions are not named-employee lines on this file.
